QuestInfo.name: The Missing Mechanical Parts
QuestInfo.1: Manager Karl asked you to find the missing Toy Factory Machine Parts. You must #btalk to Manager Karl again#k and collect 10 #i4031092##t4031092# items at the Toy Factory <Main Process 1> Area 4.
QuestInfo.2: You found the 10 Machine Parts lost in the Ludibrium Toy Factory and gave them to Manager Karl. Hopefully, the Toy Factory will run more efficiently now.

0.0: Some mechanical parts have gone missing from the Toy Factory. Without these parts, the machines don't work, and toys can't be made. Don't you see the crisis here? Don't you want to do something to prevent the weeping of hundreds of toyless children? Heck, if that's not motivation enough, I'll even give you a reward if you help us!

yes.0: Thanks so much. According to the investigation, the disappearing #i4031092##t4031092# items were taken by some of the haywire invaders here in the factory. We need those parts back to keep the factory running right. Can you get them back for us?
yes.1: Yes... If you #b#etalk to me again#k#n when you're ready, I'll send you to where the parts are hidden. But you shouldn't waste too much time... They might hide the parts even more carefully.

no.0: Is that right? I guess you're busy granting favors from a lot of people. But if you feel a change of heart, we're ready to listen.

1.0: Oh! You brought 10 #b#t4031092##k items just in time. Here, take this for your trouble. I need to get right on putting these back where they belong.

yes.0: The factory can run smoothly again thanks to you. Thanks.

default.0: If you #b#etalk to me again#k#n when you're ready, I'll send you to where the parts are hidden. Go there and get #i4031092##t4031092# items.
